# AI Lead Automation

> AI Lead Automation is a blueprint of documentation and patterns for automating lead handling in service businesses: capture, instant reply, AI qualification, CRM write, follow-up and booking. By TechAurah.

Key facts:
- License: MIT. Format: documentation and patterns in Markdown. There is no runtime, installer or hosted service.
- It is not a hosted product or SaaS: it sends nothing, hosts nothing and stores no leads. You implement the patterns in your own stack.
- Reference stack: n8n or Zapier for orchestration, an LLM for reply and qualification, your existing CRM and calendar.
- Lead scoring model: eight signals, 0-100. HOT 80+, WARM 65-79, NURTURE 50-64.
- Current version: v0.1.0.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/techaurah/ai-lead-automation): Full overview, the pipeline, the scoring model, comparison and FAQ
- [Architecture and data model](https://github.com/techaurah/ai-lead-automation/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Pipeline architecture, components and data model for the lead handling system
- [Qualification prompt patterns](https://github.com/techaurah/ai-lead-automation/blob/main/docs/qualification-prompts.md): Channel-agnostic prompts for qualifying service business leads with an LLM
- [CRM field mapping examples](https://github.com/techaurah/ai-lead-automation/blob/main/docs/crm-field-mapping.md): Field mappings for HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel and Google Sheets
- [Follow-up sequence patterns](https://github.com/techaurah/ai-lead-automation/blob/main/docs/follow-up-patterns.md): No-reply follow-up sequences, value first, with timing and stop conditions
